featured_reviews.name: Vishal Kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had hired ambulance for assisting my mom from hospital to home location. Home location didn't have lift and helpers in ambulance were required to lift the patient and drop her on 3rd floor.

Mr. Yadav promised that 2 people would do the job. The ambulance reached on time but to my surprise the driver and the helper both were not related to healthcare services and just ordinary people. To top it they were very rude and one of them was so thin, he couldn't lift a kid. The driving was horrific and very rash.

At my home location, I had to call 2 more people to help lift my mom to the 3rd floor. When the time for settlement came, Mr. Yadav calls and tells that we agreed for different amount. I had to remind him our entire conversation post which he agreed and this bad experience ended.
